cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 24 Oct 2026 with card C39 (TEST_CASES_DRAFT_22OCT.md) and robot run 47 B.4.4: the 40 mm line for pit C1, two 110 mm lines, That is enough, one completed outcome line. The 150 mm figure is a regression baseline, not an engineering approval.
cases.expected: After typing CDTWL with the two answers 10 (the detention volume in cubic metres) and 18.70 (a top water level in metres), the command line says 'Only 40 mm between the water and the lid of pit C1 (150 mm is wanted).', says 'Only 110 mm' for two more pits (P1 and P7), says 'That is enough.', asks nothing more, and the Civil log holds one 'Command outcome: CDTWL completed' line.
cases.why_not_unit: The result depends on the real pit cover levels and the installed freeboard setting read inside the drawing; the words only exist on the live command line.
not_automated: The 150 mm freeboard is a regression baseline recorded on 22 Oct, not an engineering approval of that figure (engineering judgement stays with Tim).
The two answers are those of run 47; the first prompt reads "Detention volume required, in cubic metres (from the STORM report)". The 18.70 level prompt was not read here.
